summary: Israeli forces arrested two suspects in Nablus following a deadly shooting attack near the village of Tell. The Israeli government has ordered increased security measures and home demolitions in response to recent terror incidents. Tensions remain high as US officials and Israeli leadership prepare for high-level diplomatic meetings in Washington.
key_points: Israeli commandos from the Duvdevan Unit arrested two Palestinians in a Nablus hospital following a deadly clash near the village of Tell (Source: @manniefabian/58850).
The Israeli government ordered the demolition of the home of the attacker involved in the shooting near Tell (Source: @inon_yttach/9645).
Israeli security forces are increasing operations and intelligence collection in West Bank villages following recent terror attacks (Source: @amitsegal/63345).
The US Embassy in Jerusalem issued a security alert advising citizens to exercise extreme caution due to rising tensions (Source: @yediotnews25/133166).
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is scheduled to travel to Washington to meet with President Trump (Source: @pkpoi/143427).
The Yemeni army launched a missile strike against King Khalid Air Base in Saudi Arabia's Asir region (Source: @presstv/200271).
Iraqi security forces have been deployed to areas in Baghdad, including Sadr City, to confront pro-Iranian militias (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5709).
Israeli settlers reportedly seized a house under construction north of Qarawat Bani Hassan west of Salfit (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380723).

points: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Iran determines the mechanism for transit through Hormuz under the fifth clause of a memorandum of understanding (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380743).
Araghchi accused the United States of violating agreements and seeking escalation by attempting to create separate transit paths (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380743).
The Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, Gen. Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, stated operations will continue until the enemy surrenders (Source: @presstv/200281).
Zolghadr claimed that smoke in the region indicates the targeting of American military, security, or financial centers (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380752).
The Israeli government ordered the demolition of the home of a terrorist involved in a shooting attack near the village of Tell (Source: @inon_yttach/9645).
The IDF and Shin Bet arrested two suspects in Nablus who were wounded during a clash near Tell (Source: @idf_telegram/24713).
The US Embassy in Jerusalem issued a security alert for citizens due to increasing tensions in the Middle East (Source: @yediotnews25/133166).
Prime Minister Netanyahu is traveling to Washington to meet President Trump and attend a memorial service (Source: @pkpoi/143427).
Israeli forces conducted a strike in the Shati refugee camp in the Gaza Strip (Source: @yediotnews25/133174).
Israeli commandos from the Duvdevan Unit raided a hospital in Nablus to arrest two suspects (Source: @manniefabian/58850).
UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese condemned the surge in Israeli settler violence across the West Bank (Source: @presstv/200283).
Israeli settlers reportedly seized a house under construction north of Qarawat Bani Hassan west of Salfit (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380723).
The Lebanese Army has returned to its position in the Mashaa al-Mansouri area (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380747).
Iraqi security forces have been deployed to Baghdad, including Sadr City, to confront pro-Iranian militias (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5706).
Syrian television reported 19 deaths in a collision between two buses on the Tadmor-Deir ez-Zor road (Source: @naya_foriraq/85530).
The Yemeni army conducted a missile strike against King Khalid Air Base in Saudi Arabia's Asir region (Source: @presstv/200271).
Reports indicate Bahrain and Kuwait recently attacked Iran in response to Iranian attacks on their territory (Source: @asafroz/51869).
A 'eek shelter' alert was issued in Bahrain (Source: @shin_persian/8506).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high volatility due to simultaneous kinetic actions in the West Bank and missile strikes in the Gulf region. The arrest of suspects in Nablus and subsequent orders for home demolitions indicate an escalation in Israeli counter-terror operations. Additionally, the Yemeni missile strike on a Saudi airbase demonstrates continued regional spillover.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic efforts are being tested as Iran accuses the US of violating agreements regarding Hormuz transit. Meanwhile, the US Embassy has advised citizens to prepare for potential disruptions, including flight cancellations and airspace closures, due to rising tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The deployment of Iraqi security forces in Baghdad against militias suggests heightened internal friction in Iraq. Furthermore, reports of Bahraini and Kuwaiti strikes against Iran indicate a potential shift in regional defensive/offensive postures.
